title: Palace x Oakley
dek: Hardware, snow, and a logo hood in off white. The FW24 XL is a desk note, not a jacket on the rail.
story: Palace and Oakley have been in and out of each other’s seasons since the late 2010s: eyewear, snow kit, and the odd fleece that sells out and then sits on resale for years. This page is that story, not a warehouse.
The public rail this week is five jackets. The Palace x Oakley logo hood, off white, FW24, size XL, is not one of them.
If a clean hood turns up again, a request is how the desk starts. Nothing is charged on this site.

timeline.label: The hardware years
timeline.text: Oakley lenses and frames start showing up in Palace drops. Snow and skate share a line.

timeline.label: Logo hood
timeline.text: Off white fleece, Oakley wordmark on the chest, size XL. It is not hanging this week.

timeline.label: Off the rail
timeline.text: The homepage hangs five live jackets. This hood stays in the story.

title: Trailgrip, printed
dek: A khaki Trailgrip 3D in the vault. Never worn, dust bag in the description, size noted as about EU 38. Not on the hanger rail.
story: Zellerfeld prints footwear rather than moulding it. Moncler put that process under the Trailgrip name. The pair we hold is khaki, from a Joli Closet listing described as never worn, no tags, with a dust bag.
The cut-out is that listing photograph with the white ground removed. It lives on the product page. Trainers stay off the hanger rail.
Guide price is the euro ask converted at our October 2026 rate, then the usual margin. The pair is in the vault and ships now.

timeline.label: Listing photographs
timeline.text: The Joli Closet images are dated 2025. We fetched the page on 21 Oct 2026 and it was still up.

timeline.label: Size, as described
timeline.text: The seller estimates EU 38. We will not pretend to have measured it.

timeline.label: Then we buy
timeline.text: Nothing is charged on this site. A request is how the desk starts.

title: Genius, guest chapter
dek: Black jacket, Vestiaire 72059216, size M, very good. The seller left the style name blank. The rail uses the flat lay.
story: Moncler Genius invites other houses in for a season. Palm Angels joined as 8 Moncler Palm Angels, first shown for autumn/winter 2019. That is the programme, not a style name this seller wrote.

The jacket on the rail is Vestiaire listing 72059216, black, size M International, condition very good, payable price $1,205 on 21 October 2026. The description was empty. The photograph is the seller’s flat lay, with no one in it.
Vestiaire states that a physical inspection is included before delivery. We do not invent a Moncler boutique stamp the page never gave.

timeline.label: Guest chapter
timeline.text: Palm Angels entered Moncler Genius for autumn/winter 2019. This listing does not date itself to that season.

timeline.label: The ask
timeline.text: Vestiaire showed $1,511 and $1,205. The lower figure is the payable price. Add to Bag was on the page.

timeline.label: Flat lay
timeline.text: The hanger uses the seller’s garment-only photograph. A worn shot in the same listing was rejected.

frames.caption: Seller’s flat lay, cut out for the rail

title: A shark on a lid
dek: Vivobook S 15 OLED, K5504VA, i5, 16GB, 512GB. Used, from a JP seller, or best offer.
story: BAPE and ASUS put the house print on a Vivobook S 15 OLED. The listing we are tracking is eBay UK item 376659464010: K5504VA, i5, 16GB, 512GB, used, JP seller, free returns, $1,355 or best offer.
The search index still showed it on 6 Oct 2026. A direct fetch was blocked, and the seed has no photograph. It is not on the public rail.
If you request it we open the listing, confirm the spec, and talk before anyone pays. A laptop that has been used needs a plainer conversation than a sealed hoodie.

timeline.label: The spec in the title
timeline.text: i5, 16GB, 512GB, 15-inch OLED. That is the seller’s title, not a bench test.

timeline.label: Last index update
timeline.text: We could not open the page as a bot. Treat the link as the source of truth.

timeline.label: No photo on file
timeline.text: The hanger is drawn. It is not a render of that exact unit.

title: LV Ice
dek: A snowboard with a retail reference of ¥66,000. No resale listing pinned. Vault candidate.
story: Louis Vuitton’s LV Ice snowboard is limited to 200. The page we can cite is the retail reference on louisvuitton.cn, ¥66,000, which answered 200 on 21 Oct 2026. We have not found a resale ask we are willing to pin.
There is no board on the public rail. No. 047/200 was a studio rack mark, not a serial Louis Vuitton issued.
Because of the price and the missing listing, this sits with the Rolex as a vault candidate: we will only go further with a real seller, a real board, and an authentication route you have agreed.

timeline.label: Edition size
timeline.text: The retail page states the limitation. We do not have piece numbers beyond that.

timeline.label: Retail, not resale
timeline.text: The guide in pounds is that figure converted and margined. A real resale ask will replace it.

timeline.label: No. 047/200
timeline.text: Engraved on our hanger. It is not the manufacturer’s serial.
